$Comment: The weekly warrant for an enchanter: a long week at the Disenchanting Table. STATION_INPUT counts a piece the moment a table consumes it, so a stocked chest cannot fill it; the blank Target matches every item, and the step carries the shared unmake_gear TextKey since the kind's default line names a single item. Qualifier 'Disenchanting_Table' with QualifierMatchMode PREFIX counts both tables and never the Sawmill. It hangs on the Weekly board's hard band, which that board gates through its own AcceptRequires, so nothing about who may take it is written here beyond the stations feature. This file spells out its whole step and pay rather than inheriting a shared skeleton, so it loads with nothing but this pack, RPG Stations and the MMO installed; it hangs on the Weekly board by id, and on a server with no board of that id it is simply never posted. The stations feature condition in Requires hides the contract rather than locking it: it is lifted out of the gate when the contract loads and the board's draw reads it live, so on a server where stations have been switched off the contract never takes a slot and is never posted, rather than being offered and refused at Accept.
